cases.expected: JsonSchema instance returned; jsonSchema.initializeValidators() invoked exactly once without throwing; no exception propagated.
cases.description: Happy‑path: the created JsonSchema successfully initializes its validators. The try block executes without exception, so the method returns the JsonSchema produced by doCreate.

cases.expected: JsonSchema instance returned; jsonSchema.initializeValidators() invoked and throws RuntimeException which is caught and ignored; method still returns the JsonSchema.
cases.description: Exception‑path: simulate a failure while pre‑loading $ref validators. The exception is caught inside the method, so it should not propagate and the returned JsonSchema should still be non‑null.

cases.expected: JsonSchema instance returned; internally JsonSchemaFactory.createSchemaValidatorsConfig() is invoked to supply a non‑null SchemaValidatorsConfig to createValidationContext; initializeValidators() is called once.
cases.description: When config is null the factory must create a default SchemaValidatorsConfig. The test verifies that a non‑null config is supplied to createValidationContext and that the method still returns a valid JsonSchema.

cases.expected: JsonSchema instance returned; the same SchemaValidatorsConfig instance supplied is passed unchanged to createValidationContext and subsequently to doCreate.
cases.description: Ensures that when a non‑null config is provided it is not replaced by a default config and is used throughout schema creation.

cases.expected: JsonSchema instance returned; getSchemaLocation receives a null schemaRetrievalUri and must resolve a location based on the schemaNode content (e.g., using an empty base URI). No NullPointerException is thrown.
cases.description: Verifies that the method can handle a null SchemaLocation argument, delegating to getSchemaLocation which should treat the missing URI as an empty base and still produce a valid JsonSchema.

cases.expected: NullPointerException thrown from createValidationContext or doCreate before any JsonSchema is returned.
cases.description: The method does not guard against a null schemaNode; passing null should cause a NullPointerException when the node is accessed inside createValidationContext or doCreate.

group: newJsonSchema - doCreate returns null leads to NPE

cases.expected: NullPointerException thrown when jsonSchema.initializeValidators() is invoked on a null reference; the exception propagates out of newJsonSchema.
cases.description: Mocks doCreate to return null. The subsequent call to jsonSchema.initializeValidators() dereferences null, causing a NPE that is not caught by the method. The test confirms that such a situation results in an exception rather than a silent failure.
